text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon now looks completely at home standing center stage in a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's gaining fame as an up-and-coming dirt racer, and bloggers have taken note of her concert performances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the term "Umadol" starting to become recognized, Smart Falcon drives forward toward her dream of becoming a top Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, given her ambitions on dirt, no one expects her to compete in the turf Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon overhears fans saying it's a shame they can't see Falco's high-energy performances on a stage as grand as the Triple Crown.
